Title: Harness Artifact Mirroring Guidance
Text: Date: 2026-02-08   Scope: CI/pre-merge usage of `npm run harness:validate:premerge`

Title: Perspective
Text: The current wrapper design is intentionally `summary.json`-first.  - Default behavior should stay lightweight and deterministic for pre-merge gates. - Full artifact mirroring should be an opt-in diagnostic mode, not a default. - Mirroring is valuable when triage or audit depth is required, not for every green run.

Title: Why Not Always Mirror Everything
Text: - CI storage and upload time increase substantially. - Most runs only need pass/fail + test-level details already present in `summary.json`. - Full artifacts may include more operational detail than needed for routine gating. - Keeping the default minimal reduces maintenance and retention complexity.

Path: When Full Mirroring Is Worth It
Title: When Full Mirroring Is Worth It
Text: Enable full-directory mirroring when one or more of these are true:  - A validation run fails and `summary.json` does not explain root cause. - Failures are intermittent/flaky and require cross-run evidence comparison. - Reviewers/release controls require downloadable raw evidence from CI. - You need long-lived forensic/audit records beyond `${TMPDIR}` lifecycle. - You are debugging stream-order, interrupt, permission, or parser regressions.

Title: Recommended Operating Model
Text: - Baseline: publish stable `summary.json` only. - On-demand: enable full mirroring for failing branches/runs. - Optional policy: mirror full artifacts automatically only on failure.

Title: What "Full Mirroring" Means
Text: From `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/chirality-harness-validation/latest`, mirror:  - `summary.json` - `sse/*.sse` - `api/*.json` - `logs/*.json` - `mock/**` - `cleanup/sessions.json`  to a stable CI path under `frontend/artifacts/harness/section8/latest/` (or configured equivalent).

Title: Guardrails
Text: - Keep secrets redaction guarantees intact; do not bypass logger/env-filter safety. - Apply artifact retention limits in CI (size/time). - Treat mirrored artifacts as potentially sensitive operational data.
